capabilities: Scan a vault directory and extract person metadata into a relationship graph
Render interactive family trees with collapsible parent and child nodes
Navigate and rearrange the graph with keyboard shortcuts
Switch between Brandes-Köpf and quadratic layout algorithms
Build starting graphs from a selected person and add or hide relatives
disambiguation: Not a universal graph renderer; it only visualizes family relationships between person pages.
extras: Detailed usage and metadata format documentation lives in separate METADATA.md and GETTING_STARTED.md files rather than in the README.
intentEvidence: obsidian-charted-roots is a great plugin, but it's just not for me.
motivation: The author began family research in 2025, wanted to own private information instead of storing it on sites like myheritage.com, and could not find a suitable plugin for rendering family relationship graphs.
problem: Obsidian has no way to visualize family relationships between person notes, and genealogy sites keep private family data on third-party servers.

relations.evidence: It uses the reactflow library for rendering and a custom layout algorithm
The current implementation is heavily inspired by the dagre project
obsidian-charted-roots is a great plugin, but it's just not for me

summary: Family tree viewer that renders interactive family relationship graphs from one person page per vault note in a configurable directory.
